rv.q: This article is more than 14 years old Review The Curious Incident of the Dog in the Night-Time – review This article is more than 14 years old Cottesloe, London I t doesn't matter a damn what I or my colleagues say about this adaptation of Mark Haddon's bestselling novel . Last night it was greeted with a great roar of approval.
Luke Treadaway's impersonation of Christopher Boone... is a really touching, probably award-winning, performance.
